'''EnRUPT''' is a block cipher and a family of cryptographic algorithms based on [[XXTEA]].<ref name=SASC2008/><ref>{{cite web|author1=Sean O'Neil|author2=Karsten Nohl|author3=Luca Henzen|title=EnRUPT Hash Function Specification|url=http://www.enrupt.com/SHA3/Supporting_Documentation/EnRUPT_Specification.pdf|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100713234505/http://www.enrupt.com/SHA3/Supporting_Documentation/EnRUPT_Specification.pdf|archive-date=13 July 2010|url-status=dead}}</ref>
EnRUPT hash function was submitted to [[SHA-3 competition]] but it wasn't selected to the second round.
